# maisongr-typo

> An open-source npm package (MIT, no runtime dependencies, Node 20.9+) that applies French typography to text, Markdown, HTML and JSON translation files: the Office québécois de la langue française's rules by default (fr-CA), France's with locale fr-FR. It has a CLI with a check command for CI.

fr-CA puts no space before ; ! ? (the OQLF's choice; a narrow no-break space with highPunctuation: "narrow"), a no-break space (U+00A0) before : and inside « », writes hours 8 h 30 and amounts 29 $ and 12 535 $, and ordinals 2e, 1re, 1er. fr-FR puts a narrow no-break space (U+202F) before ; ! ? and between digit groups. Links, emails, domains, entities, code, tags and link targets are never changed.

## Use it

- In code: `import { typeset, check } from "maisongr-typo"`; `typeset(text, { locale, format, keep })` returns the text; `check(text, options)` returns `{ rule, message, line, column, found, expected }[]`.
- Formats: `format: "text"` (default), `"markdown"`, `"html"`.
- Brand spellings to keep as written: `keep: ["Toqué!"]`.
- Files: `npx maisongr-typo check <files or folders>` (exit 1 when something needs fixing), `npx maisongr-typo fix <files or folders>`.
- JSON: name the file; `--only-key fr` limits it to strings under a key named fr.
- Standard input: `npx maisongr-typo < in.txt > out.txt`.
- `--json` prints a machine-readable report.
